$comment: The four wings of the house. Slugs are stable; names/accents are the owner's to change. tileOrder places the three non-app wing tiles on the home conveyor after the roster cells and before the Tools tile.

wings.name: Cells
wings.oneLiner: Small, quiet, on-device apps. No telemetry, cloud only when you say so.

wings.name: The Cabinet
wings.oneLiner: Things made here, and things kept for a while and now let go. One of each, mostly.

wings.name: Practice
wings.oneLiner: Built work as explorables, free tools for architects, and a way to commission the practice.

wings.name: Alloy prints
wings.oneLiner: Slice in your browser, print at home from your phone, or have it printed here and sent to you.
